beats.say: Your cat loves milk. Its tummy *doesn't.*
Rudi thinks every cat needs milk. So he pours a big *saucer.*
Kitty loves it, so Rudi buys a whole *crate.* A few hours later... the litter box is *busy.*
Rudi blames the store milk, so he brings home a *cow.* Same milk. Same *tummy ache.*
Kittens make an enzyme, *lactase*, to digest their mom's milk.
But after weaning, most cats make far *less* of it.
So the milk sugar ferments in the gut. Gas, cramps... *diarrhea.*
Vets at the PDSA say one saucer is like you eating a whole *pizza.*
Give your cat fresh *water.* Cat milk? Only as a rare *treat.*
So before Rudi pours another saucer... remember:
